Lemma
[Pointwise limits of convex functions] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0436 1. apph:H.6\group Euclidean convexity If finite-or-infinite-valued convex functions $f_k:\R ^n\to \R \cup \{ \infty \} $ converge pointwise to $f_\infty $, then $f_\infty $ is convex and the convergence is uniform on compact subsets where the limit is finite.
